relevance_note: Single-patient case report of a girl with Blau syndrome and a NOD2 variant: "a heterozygous mutation of the NOD2 gene c.1538T > C (p.M513T) was identified".
method_note: Read the full paper manually; no tables. One proband (label 'patient', rule 5) plus her two parents, who were tested and found negative ('the child's parents had no mutation at that site'); parents get rows labelled 'parent of patient' and 'parent of patient 2' (sex not stated), no variant rows and all-not-reported checklists. Inheritance recorded de novo because both parents were stated to lack the variant. Contradiction/inconsistency in the paper: p.M513T is described in the text as 'conversion of amino acid 513 from lysine to threonine' (M denotes methionine); recorded p.M513T as printed. Variant type not stated by the authors (left not reported). Arthritis is stated only in the Discussion/Conclusion summary ('history of rash, arthritis and binocular uveitis'); the case presentation mentions only a knee-joint cyst. Age at diagnosis not printed as an age ('diagnosed with BS one year ago' at age five); left not reported. 'No significant changes in liver and kidney functions, coagulation function' recorded as excluded abnormal liver, kidney and coagulation function (D-27); this was not used to exclude the composite checklist item 'granulomatous nephritis or renal failure'. Elevated leukocytes were not treated as ESR/CRP. Medullary sponge kidney and urinary calculi recorded as observed features. Ocular findings are recorded with laterality in severity_or_detail.
